verify.notes: V0927 _stricmp, 2 args. When 0x1460142e0 (locale-changed flag) is 0 it folds A-Z to lower case byte by byte and returns the difference at the first mismatch, so 0 means a case-insensitive match. A null a or b sets errno 22 and returns 0x7fffffff. Otherwise it tail-jumps with r8d = 0 to the locale variant, which compares through the lower-case map at locale+0x110.
